answer: Sybil resistance here rests on slashable stake plus k attestations: before an agent can earn, it must lock its own bond and gather k vouchers from already-staked peers. A farmer cannot mint free identities; every fake node needs a distinct bond plus k independent vouchers, and any peer that vouches for a node later caught cheating is slashed together with it. Cost therefore grows roughly with the square of the fake fleet, so a cheap inlet of one identity fans into a nebula of exposed links and finally drowns in one ocean of forfeited collateral.
